function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

function.name: write_markdown_tool

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most common “tools” (websites, mobile apps, APIs, and software platforms) you can use to search for, compare, and book flights.  I’ve grouped them by category so you can pick the right one for your workflow—whether you’re a casual traveler, a travel‑agent, or a developer building a flight‑booking feature.

| Category | Tool / Platform | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|-----------------|----------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing flight search & booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast, data‑rich search, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick price comparison, exploring routes |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates many airlines & OTAs, price alerts, “Everywhere” search | Budget travelers, flexible dates |
| | **Kayak** | Price comparison, price forecasts, “Explore” feature | Planning trips, comparing bundles |
| | **Momondo** | Deep price comparison, “Flight Finder” | Finding hidden deals, multi‑stop itineraries |
| | **Expedia** | Flights + hotels + car rentals, package deals | One‑stop booking, loyalty points |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price”, Express Deals | Last‑minute or discounted fares |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, with Orbitz Rewards | Frequent traveler rewards |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” for discounted flights | Budget travelers, last‑minute |
| | **Travelocity** | Flights + hotels, bundle discounts | Family or group travel |
| | **CheapOair** | Direct flight booking, promo codes | Promo‑code hunting |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile app | Mobile‑first travelers, price alerts |
| | **Trip.com / Ctrip** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency | International travelers, Asian routes |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** (flight‑booking partner) | Integrated flight booking for experiences | Experiential travel |
| | **Airline direct sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Loyalty points, seat selection, baggage | Frequent flyers, brand loyalty |
| **Mobile apps** | **Google Travel** | Trip planning, flight status, itinerary sync | All‑in‑one trip planner |
| | **Skyscanner app** | Price alerts, “Everywhere” search | On‑the‑go price monitoring |
| | **Hopper app** | Predictive pricing, booking | Mobile‑first travelers |
| | **Kayak app** | Price alerts, flight status | Quick checks |
| | **Expedia app** | Bundle deals, loyalty points | One‑stop booking |
| | **Airline apps** (e.g., Southwest, Ryanair) | Check‑in, seat selection | Airline‑specific perks |
| **Developer APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing, seat maps | Building custom booking engines |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Global distribution system (GDS) access, inventory, booking | Enterprise travel agencies |
| | **Travelport (Apollo)** | GDS, flight inventory, booking | Corporate travel solutions |
| | **Skyscanner Flights API** | Search, price alerts, flight data | Integrate flight search into apps |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel API) | Flight search, pricing, availability | Google‑powered travel apps |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, tracking | Status updates, flight tracking |
| | **OpenSky Network API** | Real‑time flight data, ADS‑B | Aviation data analytics |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Operational analytics |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, airline data | Data‑driven travel services |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking, commission | Affiliate marketing |
| | **Kayak API** (via Kayak Affiliate) | Flight search, booking, affiliate links | Affiliate travel sites |
| | **Trip.com API** | Flight, hotel, train booking | Multi‑service travel portals |
| **Travel‑agency & corporate tools** | **Concur Travel** | Corporate booking, expense integration | Business travel management |
| | **Egencia** | Corporate travel, policy compliance | Enterprise travel |
| | **SAP Ariba Travel** | Procurement‑centric booking | Corporate procurement |
| | **TravelPerk** | Corporate travel, expense integration | Modern corporate travel |
| | **CWT (Corporate Travel Management)** | Corporate booking, analytics | Enterprise travel |
| | **Amadeus Corporate** | Corporate booking, reporting | Corporate travel |
| | **Travelport GDS** | Global distribution, inventory | Travel agencies, corporate |
| **Other niche tools** | **Hopper** (mobile) | Predictive pricing, price alerts | Mobile‑first travelers |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Live flight tracking | Real‑time flight status |
| | **FlightAware** | Real‑time flight status, alerts | Status updates |
| | **TripIt** | Trip organization, flight alerts | Trip planning |
| | **Google Trips** (legacy) | Trip organization | Legacy users |
| | **Trip.com** | Flights + hotels + trains | Asian routes |
| | **Rome2rio** | Multi‑modal travel planning | Planning multi‑leg journeys |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|---------------------|
| **Fast price comparison** | Skyscanner, Kayak, Momondo |
| **Best for last‑minute deals** | Hopper, Hotwire, Priceline |
| **Bundle flights + hotels** | Expedia, Orbitz, Travelocity |
| **Airline‑specific perks** | Airline direct sites, airline apps |
| **Mobile‑first booking** | Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Travel |
| **Developer building a booking engine** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner Flights API |
| **Corporate travel management** | Concur, Egencia, TravelPerk, SAP Ariba |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware, FlightRadar24, FlightStats |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Travelpayouts, Kayak Affiliate, Skyscanner Affiliate |

---

#### Quick Tips

1. **Use price alerts** – Most aggregators (Google Flights, Skyscanner, Hopper) let you set alerts for specific routes/dates.
2. **Check airline direct** – After finding a good fare, compare with the airline’s own site; sometimes they offer lower fares or better seat selection.
3. **Bundle wisely** – If you’re also booking hotels or cars, check if a bundle saves money; sometimes the savings are only a few dollars.
4. **Leverage APIs** – If you’re building a travel app, start with Amadeus or Skyscanner’s free tier; they provide comprehensive flight data and booking capabilities.
5. **Corporate tools** – For business travel, use a platform that integrates with your expense system (Concur, TravelPerk).

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper dives into any particular platform, pricing details, or how to integrate a specific API!
